# Synthetic Mistral v3 tokenizer fixture

Generated by `scripts/hf_mistral_tokenizer_fixture.py` using tokenizers 0.22.2
and Transformers 4.57.1. The vocabulary is trained on authored test strings;
there are no pretrained weights. The exact tokenizer pipeline and plain-chat
Jinja template come from the Apache-2.0 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 revision recorded
in `validation/hf/model-profiles.json`. Go never executes that Jinja template.

The synthetic oracle runs the serialized pipeline via PreTrainedTokenizerFast.
The separate `--real` oracle checks official AutoTokenizer/SentencePiece
conversion against the original serialized pipeline. Encoding, chat framing,
lossy byte fallback, special-token skipping and streaming decoding are tested.
